calculation.description: Ranks assets by twenty-trading-day momentum multiplied by the directional consistency of daily returns and scaled by trailing daily volatility. Positive values favor persistent, risk-adjusted trends; negative values identify persistent declines.

validation.regime_notes: Short post-online sample available in the data API; all 15 instruments valid on each observation. Mean daily IC was 0.02057 with ICIR 0.07012 in 2025-26 and 0.08107 with ICIR 0.28696 in 2027, indicating regime variation. Interpret uncertainty conservatively.
